bio.text: Jeremy Gray, a Democrat, has represented Alabama House District 83 since November 7, 2018, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.
He was born in Opelika, Alabama, graduated from Opelika High School and earned a bachelor of science degree in sports management from North Carolina State University.
He is a small business owner who founded Elevate Your Grind Inc.
